Summary: [Sample Template] Incorrect product image displayed for problem_user account
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Go to https://www.saucedemo.com/
2. Login with 'problem_user' / 'secret_sauce'
3. Observe product images on Inventory page.
Expected Result: Each item shows its respective distinct product image.
Actual Result: All items display the same dog image ('sl-404.jpg').

Summary: [Sample Template] Checkout allowed when shopping cart is completely empty
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login as standard_user
2. Open Cart without adding any items
3. Click Checkout button.
Expected Result: Checkout button is disabled or an alert informs user that cart is empty.
Actual Result: User is allowed to navigate to Checkout Step 1 and complete order with $0 total.
